title: Add Combine collections + mode history to account page
body:
Give players a real account surface for their Combine progress. Today `/account` is a single page with an aggregate `StatsPanel`; there's no way to browse the collection outside the in-game `CollectionBook`, no run history, and no leaderboard entry point.

## Scope (Combine only)

Daily Link is explicitly out of scope here — parked in a separate task since Link isn't publicly visible yet.

## What to build

**1. Collections surface**
- Route: `/account/collections` (or a tabbed section on `/account`, TBD)
- Two scopes side-by-side: Endless (shared across themes) and Daily (isolated), driven by `combine_discoveries.scope`
- Per-scope: mastery grid, tier breakdown (F/N/M/C/P/S), "last discovered" timeline using `firstFoundAt`
- Reuse `CollectionBook` styling so it doesn't feel like a new visual language

**2. Combine mode history**
- Route: `/account/combine`
- Summary header: current `StatsPanel` Combine section (bests, totals, per-theme breakdown)
- Body: past-runs list from `progress` where `kind='combine'`, filterable by mode (`endless` | `fast` | `daily`) and theme (`ref`). Score, date, theme, mode columns
- Link out to the daily leaderboard (API already exists at `/api/combine/daily/leaderboard`)

## Data already in place
- `progress` has `kind`, `ref=<theme>`, `result.mode`, `result.daily`, `result.score`, `result.chapter`, `result.engineVersion`
- `combine_discoveries` scoped `endless | daily` with `firstFoundAt` and `recipeSignatures`
- Daily leaderboard API exists; needs a UI entry point

## Open questions (resolve before building)
- Collections as a nested route (`/account/collections`) or tabs on `/account`?
- Public shareable URLs (e.g. `/u/[name]/collections`) or private-only? Default private.
- Should past-runs list paginate or show "recent 50" with filter chips?
- Where do leaderboards live — inline on `/account/combine`, or a separate `/leaderboards` route?

## Suggested slicing
1. Collections page (`/account/collections`) — biggest payoff, simplest data
2. Combine mode page with run history + summary
3. Leaderboard entry point from mode page

## Non-goals
- Craft history pages (can be a follow-up; `StatsPanel` Craft section already covers aggregate bests)
- Daily Link history — separate task
- Public profile pages

title: Combine: allow ending a run early to bank score
body:
Add an explicit "End run" action in Combine that finalizes the current run, submits the score to `progress`, and offers a fresh start.

## Scope
- Endless themes (Everything, Everyday). Daily puzzle: out of scope for this pass — ending early would trivialize the puzzle (bail after one lucky discovery). Fast mode: TBD — already short, probably no button needed.
- Replay/score integrity: submit via existing run-finalize path so `ENGINE_VERSION` + server replay stays authoritative. Client cannot pick the score.
- UX: button lives on the game board (placement TBD). Confirm via `useConfirm()` hook (no native dialog — see memory). After confirm → finalize → show the same completion flow a crumble-out triggers (score summary, "play again").

## Open questions
- Where does the button live visually? (HUD corner vs. menu)
- Minimum run length before enabling, if any? (Prevents accidental one-move runs cluttering leaderboards.)
- Daily: confirm we're excluding it from v1.

comments.body:
## Approach

Existing infra does most of the work:
- `engine.ts` already has a `finish` action (engine.ts:1282) but gates it to the "last chance" state (no organic move + helpers available). Server replay also expects `over`-terminating finish (server-engine.ts:185).
- `run-store.endRun()` already exists for banking server-side.
- `CombineBoard.tsx:2355` already renders a "Finish now" button on the last-chance sheet.

Plan:
1. **Engine (`engine.ts:1282`)**: relax the `finish` guard. Allow any time in `endless` / `fast` modes; block in `daily` (matches scope decision, prevents trivial "unlock-and-bail"). No ENGINE_VERSION bump — behaviour change is strict superset gated by mode, no existing scoring changes.
2. **Board UI (`CombineBoard.tsx`)**: add an always-visible "End run" entry to the controls/menu (not duplicating the last-chance sheet button). Use `useConfirm()` for a destructive confirm dialog. Hide in daily mode.
3. **Daily**: button not rendered; engine blocks dispatch as defence-in-depth.

Not touching: server replay path, score calc, progress submission — `over: true` already flows through the existing finalize pipe.

## Landed

**Engine** — `src/combine/engine.ts:1282` (finish case): kept last-chance semantics (unchanged for daily), added new "endless/fast + score > 0 + not over" bank path. No ENGINE_VERSION bump — pure gate expansion, no scoring change. Guards evaluated on the server via replay (server-engine.ts:185 already drops post-`over` actions).

**UI**:
- `src/components/combine/board-parts/board/TopBar.tsx` — added `onEndRun` + `canEndRun` props; renders a new "End run" item in the More menu above "Send feedback". Row is omitted when caller doesn't pass `onEndRun` (daily/tutorial), disabled when `canEndRun` is false.
- `src/components/combine/CombineBoard.tsx` — new `endRunConfirm` state, passes `onEndRun` only in endless/fast when not over, `canEndRun=state.score > 0`, and a `ConfirmDialog` ("End this run?" → dispatches `{ type: "finish" }`). Esc dismisses. The existing `GameOverCard` + "Play again" flow handles restart.

**Tests** — `src/combine/__tests__/engine.test.ts`: 4 new cases for the `finish` action (endless banks, endless at score=0 no-ops, daily never banks, already-over no-ops). Full suite 453 pass / 2 skip; typecheck clean; lint clean (no new warnings).

**Scope**: daily excluded as agreed; fast included (short runs but no reason to force a full board-fill).

Follow-ups not taken:
- Minimum run length beyond score > 0 — decided against; one combo earning score is a legitimate run.
- Score > 0 could hide the button below a visible-score threshold in UX if it feels wrong in play.

title: combine: eliminate load flash between placeholder and restored save
body:
## Problem

When loading /combine with a saved run, users see the deterministic SSR placeholder (empty 6×6 seed=42 board + empty trays) for 1–2 frames before an effect swaps in the restored save state. Visible pop, feels bad. A spinner would feel worse (introduces delay that isn't there — the local load is near-instant).

## Root cause

`src/components/combine/CombineBoard.tsx:248-250` seeds `useState` with a fresh `newGame(seed=42)` for SSR hydration determinism, then the load effect (lines 352-506) reads localStorage / server probe and calls `setState(loaded)` on the next render tick.

## Approach — Option C (hybrid)

Signed-in users get a server-side hint that a save exists, so they boot straight into a "restoring" state with shimmer placeholder tiles. Guests fall back to the same shimmer path until the localStorage load completes. Fresh runs skip the shimmer entirely.

### Steps

1. **Server probe for active run.** In `src/components/combine/CombinePageBody.tsx`, when the viewer is authed, call `getActiveRun()` (or equivalent cheap existence check) per theme and pass a `hasActiveRun: Record<Theme, boolean>` prop to `<CombineBoard />`. For guests, pass `null` (unknown).

2. **Introduce `loaded` state in CombineBoard.** New boolean, starts `false` when `hasActiveRun[activeTheme] === true` OR when viewer is a guest (unknown). Starts `true` immediately when `hasActiveRun[activeTheme] === false` (fresh run, no shimmer needed). Flipped to `true` at the end of the existing load effect (both local and server paths).

3. **Placeholder tile component.** New `PlaceholderTile` in `src/components/combine/PlaceholderTile.tsx` — same chrome/geometry as `Tile` (so layout doesn't shift when real tiles arrive), but renders a subtle shimmer (CSS gradient + pulse animation) instead of a pictogram. No text, no border accent.

4. **Render placeholders while `!loaded`.** In `CombineBoard`:
   - Board slots: render `PlaceholderTile` at every slot position (use configured board size, same as the real render path).
   - Trays: render N placeholders where N is the tray's configured max. Hide score/combo/multiplier chrome (or render them with muted "—" copy).
   - Interaction disabled — the board accepts no clicks while `!loaded`.

5. **Reveal animation.** When `loaded` flips true, the real tiles mount with a quick staggered fade/scale-in (~120–180ms total, ~20ms stagger per tile). Use the existing tile mount animation if there is one; otherwise a simple CSS keyframe on tile first-paint. The shimmer tiles fade out as the real tiles fade in — same position, no layout shift.

6. **SSR safety.** The server render still emits the placeholder (now shimmer). Hydration matches because `loaded` always starts `false` on first client render whenever `hasActiveRun !== false`. Only `hasActiveRun === false` boots directly into the real fresh-run state, which is already deterministic.

### Files touched

- `src/components/combine/CombinePageBody.tsx` — add server-side active-run probe, thread prop.
- `src/components/combine/CombineBoard.tsx` — `loaded` state, gate render, reveal animation.
- `src/components/combine/PlaceholderTile.tsx` — new.
- `src/app/globals.css` — shimmer keyframes (if not already present).
- Possibly `src/combine/runs.ts` or wherever `getActiveRun` lives — expose a lightweight `hasActiveRun(userId, theme)` if the current query is heavier than needed.

### Tradeoffs / open questions

- **Fast mode and daily:** same treatment, but the server probe needs to key by theme + scope (endless vs daily) to avoid false positives.
- **Reconcile path:** if a server reconcile fires later (409 drift), we're already past `loaded`; no shimmer needed, that's a different code path.
- **Engine version:** no engine change, no `ENGINE_VERSION` bump.
- **Perf:** the server-side active-run probe adds one cheap DB query per theme on signed-in page loads. Cache-friendly (same per-request).

### Out of scope

- Reworking the load effect itself.
- Server-side localStorage mirror (not possible for guests).
- Loader/spinner UI (explicitly rejected).

## Exit criteria

- Signed-in user with an active endless save lands on /combine → sees shimmer placeholders, then real tiles fade in. No empty-board flash.
- Signed-in user with no saves lands on /combine → sees the fresh starter tiles immediately, no shimmer.
- Guest with localStorage save → sees shimmer briefly, then restored tiles.
- Guest with no save → very brief shimmer, then starter tiles. (Acceptable; could be optimized later by probing localStorage in a layout effect before first paint.)
- Hydration warnings: none.
- Daily and fast modes get the same treatment.

comments.body:
## Landed

**Approach deviation from plan:** scope narrowed. ChapterBar / Shelf / TopBar / TipLine stay rendered during the skeleton window (not just real-UI only) so there's no vertical layout shift when the swap happens — user requested this explicitly during implementation. Only the Board + Hold + Tray are swapped between skeleton and live.

### Files

- `src/components/combine/board-parts/board/BoardPlaceholder.tsx` (new) — shimmer skeleton. Reuses `.cbboard` / `.cbholdrow` / `.cbtray` / `.cbshelf.cbhold` classes with `cb-skel-*` modifiers so geometry is byte-identical to the live layout. 36 `.cbc.cb-skel-cell` + 3 `.cbp.cb-skel-tile` + 3 `.cbslot.cb-skel-slot`.
- `src/components/combine/CombinePageBody.tsx:155-167, 199` — server-side `hasActiveRunHint` probe. Only runs for signed-in viewers under `COMBINE_SERVER_RUNS`; one `listActiveRuns` query. Null for guests + local-only viewers ("unknown → show shimmer").
- `src/components/combine/CombineBoard.tsx:189-199, 228, 263-270, 383-388, 2335-2340, 2436-2437` — new `hasActiveRunHint` prop + `loaded` state. `loaded` initially `true` only when the server confidently reports no save (`hasActiveRunHint === false`), else `false`. Flipped true at the top of the existing mount-time resume effect, batched with any `setState()` the effect fires in the same tick.
- `src/app/globals.css:1068-1109` — `.cb-skel-*` shimmer styles, stagger across the 6×6 grid using `:nth-child(6n+N)`, and `.cb-live-stagger` fade-in keyframes for when the real tiles mount. Honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.

### Behaviour

| Viewer | Save exists | Mount sees | After resume effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Signed-in + server-runs on | yes | shimmer | real tiles fade in |
| Signed-in + server-runs on | no | **real fresh starter immediately** | no change |
| Signed-in + server-runs off | unknown | shimmer | real tiles fade in |
| Guest | unknown | shimmer | real tiles fade in |

### Verified

- `npm run typecheck` clean (only pre-existing warnings).
- `npm test` — 455 pass / 2 skipped (unchanged).
- `npm run build` succeeds.
- `curl /combine` on dev server: SSR emits 36 `cb-skel-cell` + 3 `cb-skel-tile` + 3 `cb-skel-slot` and the real `cbboard` / `cbtray` are **absent** at first paint. ChapterBar / Shelf / TopBar / TipLine all present in SSR for layout stability.

### Follow-ups / not done

- No `ENGINE_VERSION` bump — reducer unchanged.
- The real-tiles `cb-live-stagger` animation class isn't yet applied to the live components — the fade-in keyframes are ready in CSS but wiring them on real `Board` / `Tray` / `Hold` would need per-tile classes. Current experience is: skeleton holds, then real tiles pop in without a stagger. If that still feels abrupt, pass a one-shot `.cb-live` wrapper class from CombineBoard when `loaded` first flips. Flagged for a follow-up tweak once we see it in-browser.
- No visual browser test performed — change is structural + CSS; relied on SSR output verification. If the shimmer looks off in-app, iterate on `.cb-skel-cell::after` gradient + delay cadence.

title: Combine: account-level XP / player levels
body:
Layer a persistent account-level XP/level system on top of Combine's per-run scores. Today scores aggregate per user as `totalScoreEver` but there's no persistent progression — chapter progression resets every run.

## What already exists

- Per-run scoring: `src/combine/engine.ts:494` (tier × chain × recipe-length + close-call/terminal/chapter bonuses)
- Server-computed persistence: `src/app/api/combine/runs/[id]/finish/route.ts:208` writes `progress` rows (`src/db/schema.ts:480`)
- Lifetime aggregation: `src/lib/stats/combine.ts:110` already sums `totalScoreEver`, `bestScoreEver`, per-theme + Fast bucket
- User table (`src/db/schema.ts:375`): no `xp`/`level` columns yet
- Natural UI slots: `GameOverCard.tsx:175`, account stats page, in-game HUD

## Design question (unresolved — needs user decision before implementation)

`totalScoreEver` is already a lifetime number. "Level" over the same score is a cosmetic re-encoding unless XP is decoupled from raw score. Three options:

1. **Derived levels** — compute level from `totalScoreEver` with a log curve. Zero schema change, ~1 day. Vanity only, no retention hook.
2. **XP ledger** — score + first-discovery bonuses + daily-completion bonuses + streak bonuses. Pulls players toward daily/collection, not just endless grinding. Needs ledger table. Real retention levers (streaks, 2× XP days).
3. **Prestige / cosmetics** — levels unlock badges / profile flair / leaderboard tier names. Pairs with 1 or 2.

Recommendation: start with option 1 (derived levels, no schema change, just a formula + badge in GameOverCard + account stats). Only add a ledger if we want daily/streak mechanics.

## Open questions for user

- Which option(s)?
- If derived: level curve shape? (e.g. level N at `floor(log1.5(score/100))`)
- Where should the level badge appear? (GameOverCard only, or also HUD + account page)
- Backfill existing users from their `totalScoreEver`?

## Not started — awaiting direction

No code touched yet. File task per CLAUDE.md "just add it" convention.

## Open questions

title: Combine daily: playtest fixes (ranking, finds log, start dialog, timing, end-card polish)
body: Playtest feedback on the Combine daily puzzle. A grab-bag of issues ranging from scoring-fairness to end-card polish. Need to triage into shippable slices before implementing. **User-reported issues:** 1. **Daily is too easy.** A 40-discovery run completes in ~2 minutes. The current target-list format reduces to "combine a lot of things fast" — no constraint forces the player to think about specific targets. 2. **"Finds log" / manifest-type approach.** User wants a specified list of items the player must find (not just any 40 discoveries). More logical/thematic; also harder. How to make this playable/fair under a shared daily seed? 3. **Rank is broken — leaderboard doesn't post.** Rank shows but the player's submitted run doesn't appear. Needs investigation; could be `handle` null, `writeDiscoveries` throwing before progress commit, or the ranking fetch running before `/finish` returns. 4. **Game-end dialog style broken.** `GameOverCard` layout / CSS regression — likely from recent ResponsiveSheet changes. 5. **Badge on "used stuff" / shelf is truncated.** The `cbslot` count badge (`{n}`) overflows/truncates when n≥2 digits or on narrow widths. 6. **Add time taken.** Surface elapsed run time on the end card (and probably store it in `progress.result.durationMs`). 7. **Start-daily dialog.** Daily needs an explicit "Start daily" confirmation before the board reveals. Timer runs from Start → end dialog. Starting from first tile is unfair because players see the board while deciding to engage. 8. **"How to make this manifest-type approach playable/fair?"** Open design question tied to #2 — a hand-picked find-list has to be reachable from the daily seed's dealer. Probably needs the daily generator to simulate forward and confirm all list items are reachable, and the UI to show the list up-front (like a shopping list with checkmarks). **Files to look at:** - `src/combine/daily-config.ts`, `daily-config-db.ts`, `daily-schedule-db.ts` — target resolution, payload build. - `src/combine/engine.ts` — `state.target`, `state.found`, win condition; may need a `targets: string[]` field for the manifest variant. - `src/app/api/combine/runs/[id]/finish/route.ts:182-220` — where `progress` is written; result shape is where `durationMs` and finds-log progress should land. - `src/app/api/combine/daily/leaderboard/route.ts` — leaderboard SQL; may need to handle the "rank broken" root cause. - `src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/GameOverCard.tsx` — end-card style + badge truncation + time display + manifest completion summary. - `src/components/combine/CombinePageBody.tsx` — daily payload wiring; needs start-dialog gate. - `src/app/admin/combine/daily/DailyAdmin.tsx` — admin surface for curating the manifest list. **Suggested slice order (to confirm with user):** - A. Debug/fix rank-posting (verify `/finish` writes progress; check leaderboard query against a real finished run). - B. End-card polish: style regression, badge truncation, show time-taken. - C. Start-daily dialog + elapsed timer (store `durationMs` in `progress.result`; show on end card + leaderboard). - D. Design pass on manifest/find-list variant (separate spike task — needs a design note before code). **Scoring-affecting?** Any change that alters `target`, `found`, or the win condition likely needs an `ENGINE_VERSION` bump (per CLAUDE.md hard rule). Not starting work — this is a triage task. User can split into slices or redirect priority.

title: Combine daily: fix rank / leaderboard not posting
body:
Playtest: player finishes a daily, sees rank "—" / unranked, and their row never appears on the leaderboard.

**Suspects:**
- `/api/combine/runs/[id]/finish` writes `progress` only if `session.user.id` exists (`route.ts:180-220`). Anon runs end cleanly but never rank — verify the playtest account was signed in.
- The `progress` insert is wrapped in try/catch and swallows errors to `console.error` (`route.ts:217-220`). An insert failure wouldn't surface to the client. Check server logs for `[runs/finish] progress insert failed`.
- `writeDiscoveriesFromState` runs after the progress insert and also swallows errors — not related to ranking, but worth confirming the finish path reaches the insert at all.
- `useDailyRank` in `GameOverCard.tsx:309` matches by `handle`. If the user's `user.handle` is null (no handle set), `rows.findIndex((r) => r.handle === handle)` never matches → "unranked". Check: does the playtest account have a handle?
- Race: the ranking fetch runs on mount; the progress insert is awaited before `/finish` returns, so by the time the card mounts the row should be committed. But `useDailyRank` fires from `GameOverCard` mount — confirm `/finish` actually resolved before the card rendered (vs. optimistic end).
- Leaderboard SQL filters `ref = <theme>` and `result->>'daily' = <day>`. If `run.theme` differs from `activeDaily.themeCode` (daily-host theme ≠ active theme), the row goes under the wrong ref. Verify with a real finished daily row.

**Plan of attack:**
1. Reproduce: finish a daily locally as a signed-in user with a handle set.
2. Check `progress` table for the row (ref, daily, user_id, result shape).
3. If row exists but leaderboard GET is empty → debug SQL (likely handle/day mismatch).
4. If row missing → trace `/finish` path; add structured logging if the error swallow is masking.
5. If handle is null → either enforce handle before daily submit, or widen the ranking match to user_id (requires leaking id — don't).

Not scoring-affecting; no ENGINE_VERSION bump.

comments.body:
**Addition: admin replay of daily.**

Also allow admins to replay the daily so they can do multiple runs (for playtesting/debugging). Current state:

- **Server side is permissive already.** `/api/combine/runs/start` (`start/route.ts:65-81`) accepts `restart: true` to end the active run and mint a fresh one; `/finish` just inserts another `progress` row per completion. The leaderboard `DISTINCT ON (user_id)` in `daily/leaderboard/route.ts:48` already keeps each user to their best attempt, so multiple admin runs don't pollute standings — they just update the best.
- **Client side is the blocker.** `CombineBoard.tsx` reads `loadDailyDone(todayKey())` and switches the UI into a "you've played today" state once a daily is completed (see `CombineBoard.tsx:381, 483, 515, 1411`). Admins hit the same lock.

**Plan:**
1. Gate the client-side `dailyDone` lock on `!isAdmin`. Thread admin flag into `CombineBoard` (probably via a prop from `CombinePageBody` which already does `getSession()` / `isAdmin()` server-side).
2. When admin: allow re-entering the daily post-completion. The "Play again" button on `GameOverCard` for a daily already dispatches an endless run (`GameOverCard.tsx:291`). Admins should get a third option: "Replay daily" that POSTs `{ mode: 'daily', restart: true }` to `/api/combine/runs/start` and reloads.
3. Verify the leaderboard best-attempt dedup actually works end-to-end once ranking is fixed — this gives us a convenient test loop for T-0234 itself.

**Not scoring-affecting** — admin convenience only. Make sure non-admin behaviour is unchanged (the lock stays enforced for regular players so they still get one real attempt).

**Landed.**

Root cause of "rank broken" was a race: `GameOverCard.useDailyRank` fired its `/api/combine/daily/leaderboard` GET on mount, while `CombineBoard` called `void run.finish()` without awaiting — so the rank lookup almost always ran before the `/finish` POST inserted the `progress` row. Secondary: when `currentUserHandle` is null the hook stays `idle` forever and the UI shows "—" with label "to rank today", which read as broken.

**Changes:**
- `src/combine/useCombineRun.ts` — added `finishing: boolean` state; set true around the `/finish` POST so the UI can gate on it. `finish()` now also accepts an `extras` arg for threading `durationMs` and friends into the body.
- `src/app/api/combine/runs/[id]/finish/route.ts` — accepts `durationMs` in body (validated, capped at 24h, defaults to null) and writes it to `progress.result.durationMs` for daily runs.
- `src/app/api/combine/daily/leaderboard/route.ts` — leaderboard sort now `(found DESC, turns ASC, durationMs ASC, score DESC)`. Response includes `durationMs` (null for legacy rows / rows outside the 24h cap). Missing-duration rows sort last via a MAX_INT sentinel so timed runs beat untimed.
- `src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/GameOverCard.tsx` — accepts `finishing` + `durationMs` + `isAdmin` + `onReplayDaily`; `useDailyRank` gates on `!finishing` so the fetch waits for the insert. Rank label improved: shows "…/saving run" while finishing, "set handle to rank" when signed-in but handle null, rather than the old "—/to rank today" that looked broken. Added "Replay daily" button in the footer, admin-only.
- `src/components/combine/CombineBoard.tsx` — passes `finishing`/`isAdmin`/`onReplayDaily` through. Threaded `durationMs` into `run.finish()` on daily game-over. **Admin bypass for `loadDailyDone`**: all three gates (lines ~495, ~527, ~1411 pre-edit) now allow admins to re-enter today's daily. Added `replayDaily` handler that clears the local daily-done record and mints a fresh engine run; the slot-alignment effect takes care of POSTing `/runs/start` with the new state.

**Verified:**
- `npm run typecheck` clean
- `npm run lint` clean (only pre-existing warnings)
- `npm test` all 455 passing
- `npm run build` succeeds

Status → done.

title: Combine daily: start-dialog + elapsed timer (time-taken on end card & leaderboard)
body:
Daily today reveals the board immediately. Unfair: a player can see the tiles, bail, then "start" fresh elsewhere. Also no notion of time-taken anywhere, which the user wants surfaced.

**Scope:**
1. **Start-daily dialog.** Before the board renders for daily mode, show a "Start daily" sheet (title, day key, target count, Start button). Board stays hidden/blurred until confirmed. Endless/fast unchanged.
2. **Elapsed timer.** Start timestamp = moment the player confirms Start. End timestamp = `/finish` resolves (or client `gameOver` fires). Store `durationMs` in `progress.result` and stamp it onto the engine's final state so replay can verify.
3. **Show time on the end card.** Add a "time" stat to the daily `cb3` grid — currently (turns, discoveries, rank); make it 4-up or swap one. User's call on layout.
4. **Leaderboard tie-break by duration?** Currently sorts `(found DESC, turns ASC, score DESC)`. Add `durationMs ASC` as a tie-breaker before score? — spike + confirm with user.

**Files:**
- `src/components/combine/CombinePageBody.tsx` — gate daily render on a `dailyStarted` client flag; show start sheet before `CombineBoard` mounts for daily.
- `src/components/combine/CombineBoard.tsx` — thread start timestamp into state / engine.
- `src/combine/engine.ts` — optionally stamp `startedAt` / `endedAt` on `GameState`; or keep timing purely client-side and attach `durationMs` to the finish POST body + server-trust it (lower stakes than score).
- `src/app/api/combine/runs/[id]/finish/route.ts` — read `durationMs` from body, include in `resultValue.durationMs` for daily runs.
- `src/app/api/combine/daily/leaderboard/route.ts` — optional duration tie-break.
- `src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/GameOverCard.tsx` — render time; probably `mm:ss` for <1h and `h:mm:ss` beyond.

**Design question for user:** is `durationMs` server-trusted (client sends it) or server-measured (run `startedAt` set at first action, `endedAt` set at `/finish`)? Server-measured is more honest but weakens with pauses/tab-away. Suggest server-measured with no pause allowance — if you're tabbed away, the clock still runs.

**Scoring-affecting?** Adding `durationMs` to the result payload doesn't change score math → no ENGINE_VERSION bump needed. Changing leaderboard sort order doesn't change the engine either. If we add `startedAt`/`endedAt` to GameState and persist via the reducer, the reducer's output shape changes but not its computed values — still arguably no bump. Confirm.

Depends on T-0235 (end-card style) landing first so the time stat lands in a fixed layout.

comments.body:
**Landed (in `c3d4011` alongside T-0234/T-0235).**

**Decision log:**
- Timer: client-measured, server-trusted. `durationMs` is captured on the client via `dailyStartRef` (ms since player confirmed Start) and sealed at game-over into the `/finish` POST body. **Not** in `GameState` → no `ENGINE_VERSION` bump. Honest anti-cheat is weak (as noted in original design question) but the number isn't a scoring input.
- Start sheet trigger: fires whenever a fresh daily (`moves === 0 && !state.over && dailyStartRef.current == null`) lands after resume. Resumed-in-progress dailies skip the gate (player already committed). Admin replay re-arms the sheet.
- Dismiss behaviour: dismissing the scrim counts as "confirm Start" so the board can't get stuck behind an uncommitted sheet.
- Format: `mm:ss` under one hour; `h:mm:ss` beyond. Rounds down to the second so the clock doesn't flicker millis.
- Leaderboard sort: `(found DESC, turns ASC, durationMs ASC, score DESC)`. MAX_INT sentinel for legacy rows so timed runs beat untimed.

**Files touched** (see commit for exact ranges):
- `src/combine/useCombineRun.ts` — `finishing` state + `extras` arg on finish().
- `src/app/api/combine/runs/[id]/finish/route.ts` — `durationMs` validated + persisted.
- `src/app/api/combine/daily/leaderboard/route.ts` — sort + response.
- `src/components/combine/CombineBoard.tsx` — start sheet, timer refs, replayDaily.
- `src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/GameOverCard.tsx` — time column, `formatDuration` helper.
- `src/app/globals.css` — `.cb4` grid + `.cbstartdaily` modifier.

Status → done.

title: Combine daily: design spike for manifest / find-list variant
body:
Design-first spike. User feedback: "a 40 find game in 2 mins is too easy." Wants a **manifest / find-list** variant where the daily hands the player a specific set of items to discover (not "any 40 discoveries"). More thematic; forces thought; harder.

**Open design questions:**
1. **List composition.** Is the manifest 100% required (all N items or you don't win), or a weighted score where more-found = better rank? Weighted is softer on new players but blurs the "daily puzzle" identity.
2. **List size.** Target discoveries today = 40 (configurable via `daily-config.ts`). A manifest of 40 specific items is probably too long to display. Suggest 8–12 named items with pictograms visible on the start card and a shelf-style tracker during play.
3. **Reachability guarantee.** A hand-curated list can be unreachable from the daily seed's dealer. Either:
   - (a) Admin curates the list, generator **verifies reachability** by simulating forward with the daily RNG and either accepts or rejects the list (reject → admin picks another).
   - (b) Generator **picks** the list from items reachable in the simulated run (removes curation but guarantees solvability).
   - (c) Hybrid: admin picks a **theme/category** (e.g., "woodworking tools"), generator picks N items from that category that are reachable.
4. **Dealer bias toward manifest items.** If the dealer doesn't favour the manifest's prerequisites, the player can run out of moves without a chance. Options: (i) bias the dealer to inject manifest items' needed partners earlier; (ii) make the manifest items themselves "guest ingredients" (reuse existing `guestIngredient` scaffolding in `daily-config.ts`); (iii) extend chapter progression to shortcut toward the manifest.
5. **Fairness under a shared seed.** Every player sees the same list, same dealer. Score becomes (manifest_found, turns, durationMs) — hard to game.
6. **UI shape.** Start card lists the manifest with pictograms. During play, show a slim "finds log" sheet (collapsible) with checkmarks. End card shows the manifest with checkmarks + unfound items greyed.
7. **Collection interaction.** Manifest finds still write to `combine_discoveries` with `scope='daily'` (unchanged). No new scope needed.
8. **Backwards compat.** Keep target-count daily as an admin toggle; manifest is opt-in per theme/day. `DailyConfig` gets a new optional `manifest?: { items: string[] } | { category: string; size: number }` branch.

**Deliverables for the spike:**
- One-page design note under `docs/COMBINE_DAILY_MANIFEST.md` (new) with: the chosen variant (user picks from 1/2/3), reachability-verification algorithm, UI wireframe sketches (ASCII fine), engine changes (`GameState.manifest: string[]`, `GameState.manifestFound: string[]`, win condition), ENGINE_VERSION bump plan.
- Admin surface sketch for curating manifest per daily.
- No code yet.

**Dependencies:** None — can be worked in parallel with T-0234/T-0235/T-0236, but implementation will depend on all three landing first + the user signing off on the design note.

**Scoring-affecting?** Yes — win condition changes, so implementation will need `ENGINE_VERSION` bump (hard rule).

title: Combine: rename legacy "age" CSS/code to "chapter"
body:
Code smell flagged during T-0233 playtest. The player-facing vocabulary is **chapter** (see `bundle.theme.ages` array labelled "Chapter 1", "Chapter 2", …) but the CSS classes, event names, and internal helpers still use the legacy **age** term:

- `.cbagebig`, `.cbagepromo`, `.cbagetoast`, `.cbagebody`, `.cbagesweep`, `.cbagesample`, `.cbagepop`, `.cbageheadroom`, `.cbagegrants`, `.cbagelist`, `.cbagesheet`, `.cbagechainnode` — grep `globals.css` for `cbage` for the full list.
- Engine event `chapter-up` is already renamed, but adjacent state like `AgeToast`, `AgePromoToast`, `state.chapter` vs `bundle.theme.ages[]` are inconsistent. `bundle.theme.ages[]` is still an array of age/chapter labels.
- `loadSeenAges` / `saveSeenAges` in `storage.ts`.
- `newAgeBanner` state + `activeAgeBanner` in `CombineBoard.tsx`.
- `derive-ages.test.ts`, `promoteSeason(theme, ages)` arg naming.

**Not urgent** — purely a naming consistency issue. Wait until there's quiet to do this so the diff doesn't collide with in-flight combine work.

**Scope:**
1. CSS class rename (`cbage* → cbch*` or `cbchapter*`); update all consumers in `src/components/combine/**/*.tsx`.
2. Component rename (`AgeToast → ChapterToast`, `AgePromoToast → ChapterPromoToast`) + file renames.
3. Internal helpers (`loadSeenAges → loadSeenChapters`, `newAgeBanner → newChapterBanner`, etc).
4. `bundle.theme.ages` → consider `bundle.theme.chapters`. This is load-bearing on serialisation — may need a migration on `combine_themes.ages` if that's where the labels live. Check schema before diving.

**Not scoring-affecting** — no `ENGINE_VERSION` bump needed if nothing in the reducer changes shape. BUT if `bundle.theme.ages` → `bundle.theme.chapters` in serialisation, the server replay would break on old saved states — that part might force a bump. Audit before renaming the bundle field.

Captured during T-0233 session.

title: Rename legacy `age` terminology to `chapter` across Combine
body:
Combine has fully moved to **chapter-based progression** (see CLAUDE.md), but legacy `age` naming still permeates the code: CSS classes (`cbage*`), component names (`AgeToast`, `AgePromoToast`), state (`ageToast`, `activeAgeBanner`, `latestAgeUp`), the `bundle.theme.ages: string[]` field, the DB column `combine_themes.num_ages`, the share URL param `an`, and some user-visible strings ("reached Age X", "Chapter X has emerged" is fine, but "the X age" in share/OG copy is not).

## Scope (per user review 2026-11-08)

1. **Code + DB migration** — rename `theme.ages` → `theme.chapters`; add Drizzle migration for `num_ages` → `num_chapters`.
2. **Share URL param `an` → `cn`** — accept that in-flight OG links lose the chapter label (low traffic).
3. **User-visible copy** — update "Age X" strings to "Chapter X" where they leak into share text / OG.

## Surface (from grep)

**CSS (`src/app/globals.css`)** — all `.cbage*` classes + keyframes `cbagesweep`, `cbageheadroom`, `cbagepop` → `.cbch*` (match existing `cbdisc` / `cbchip` prefix style).

**TSX class consumers:**
- `src/components/combine/board-parts/board/ChapterBar.tsx` (cbage, cbageinfo)
- `src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/JourneySheet.tsx` (cbagesheet, cbagelist, cbagerow*, cbageno, cbagemeta, cbagefinds)
- `src/components/combine/board-parts/toasts.tsx` (cbagepromo, cbagebody, cbagetoast, cbagebig, cbagesweep, cbagegrants)

**TS identifiers:**
- `AgeToast`, `AgePromoToast` → `ChapterToast`, `ChapterPromoToast` (`toasts.tsx`, imported in `CombineBoard.tsx`)
- State/local vars in `CombineBoard.tsx`: `ageToast`, `setAgeToast`, `latestAgeUp`, `activeAgeBanner`, `dr.ageName` → chapter equivalents
- `ThemeMenu.tsx`: `dailyDone.ageName`
- `bundle.theme.ages` → `bundle.theme.chapters` in `src/combine/types.ts` + every consumer:
  - `src/combine/engine.ts` (`totalAges`)
  - `src/combine/data.ts` (`numAges`, `ages: ["Fast"]`)
  - `src/combine/share.ts` (`ages[state.chapter]`, `ageName`)
  - `src/combine/season.ts` (comment)
  - `src/app/combine/og/route.tsx` (`ageName`, `showAges`, query param `an`)
  - `src/app/api/admin/combine/bands/route.ts` (`effectiveAges`, `ageNames`)
  - `scripts/inspect-recipes.ts`
  - Tests: `__tests__/engine.test.ts`, `data.test.ts`, `mastery.test.ts`, `match.test.ts`, `hint.test.ts`, plus sim harnesses `simulate.ts`, `promote-sim.ts`, `measure.ts`, `stuck-diagnostic.ts` (lots of `numAges`, `perAge`, `avgMovesPerAge`, `AgeStats`, `finalAge`)
- `src/combine/storage.ts` run record has `ageName`
- `src/combine/share.ts` + `og/route.tsx` URL param `an` → `cn`

**DB:**
- `src/db/schema.ts:649` `numAges: integer("num_ages")` → `numChapters: integer("num_chapters")`
- Drizzle migration renames the column

**User-visible copy:**
- `CombineBoard.tsx:1561` share text `reached Age ${dr.ageName}` → `reached Chapter ${dr.chapterName}`
- `og/route.tsx:106` `Reached the ${ageName} age` → chapter wording
- `share.ts:44` `reached ${ageName}` and `:125` `reached the ${ageName} age` → chapter wording
- `ThemeMenu.tsx:65` `{dailyDone.ageName}. A new one tomorrow.` — reword if needed

## Plan

1. Rename `theme.ages` → `theme.chapters` in `types.ts`; fix all `.ts` consumers (engine, data, share, season, og, admin bands, scripts, tests).
2. Rename sim/test locals (`numAges`, `perAge*`, `AgeStats`, `finalAge`).
3. Rename component names + CombineBoard state + ThemeMenu prop.
4. Rename all `.cbage*` CSS classes + keyframes and update consumer TSX className strings. Decide on prefix — propose `cbch` (chapter) to match the `cbdisc`/`cbchip` style. Also `.cbover.cbagesheet`, `.rsheet.cbagesheet`, `.cbscrim.cbagescrim` compound selectors.
5. Share URL param `an` → `cn` in both writer (`share.ts`) and reader (`og/route.tsx`). Accept in-flight OG links lose chapter label.
6. Update user-visible "Age" strings to "Chapter".
7. Drizzle: rename `num_ages` → `num_chapters`; generate migration (`npm run db:generate`); verify SQL is a simple RENAME COLUMN.
8. Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`. Watch the sim scripts compile.
9. Spot-check Combine UI in dev: ChapterBar renders, JourneySheet opens, toasts fire on chapter-up.

## Not in scope

- `combine_discoveries.scope` or progression math — this is pure rename.
- `chapter` field on game state (already named `chapter`); no changes needed there.
- `ENGINE_VERSION` bump — rename doesn't change reducer output. Confirm with user if any behavior change sneaks in.

title: Combine manifest · step 1: schema + payload (DailyConfig.manifest, DailyPayload v2)
body:
**Step 1 of 6** per `docs/COMBINE_DAILY_MANIFEST.md`. Pure data shape — plus the engine's `state.target` rip-out (merged from T-0241 because splitting leaves dead `target: null` passthroughs that violate 'no dead code').

**REVISED SCOPE (post user decision 2026-11-08):** Target-count daily is being **ripped out entirely** — manifest becomes THE daily. Only 2 playtesters in prod; `combine_dailies` + `progress WHERE kind='combine'` will be truncated.

**Scope:**
1. **Delete** from `src/combine/daily-config.ts`: `DailyConfig.targetDiscoveries`, `DailyConfig.targetByDow`, `DEFAULT_TARGET_DISCOVERIES`, `resolveDailyTarget`, related normaliser branches + tests.
2. Add `DailyConfig.manifest: { pool: string; size: number; pins?: string[]; partnerBias?: number }`. Validate: pool non-empty, size 6-12 (default 8), pins ≤ size + unique, partnerBias 0-2 (default 0.3).
3. `src/combine/daily-schedule.ts`:
   - Delete `targetDiscoveries` from `DailyPayload`.
   - Add required `manifest: string[]` on every payload.
   - Version stays 1 (no v2 bump — wipe handles migration).
4. `src/combine/server-engine.ts`: delete `dailyTargetForRun`; add `dailyManifestForRun`.
5. **Engine rip-out** (merged from T-0241, needed to avoid dead `target: null` passthroughs):
   - Delete `GameState.target`.
   - Delete `target` from `NewGameOpts`.
   - Delete the target-win branch in `afterMove` (lines ~593-597).
   - Delete `target` from `StoredGame` / `hydrateGame` / `fromStored`.
   - Clean up UI readers: `CombineBoard.tsx` start-sheet, `GameOverCard.tsx`, `JourneySheet.tsx`, `ChapterBar.tsx`, `share.ts`.
   - **Bump `ENGINE_VERSION` 2 → 3**.
6. Leaderboard page/component switch from `targetByDay: number | null` to a manifest-size field driven off `payload.manifest.length`.
7. Admin UI `DailyAdmin.tsx`: strip target-count inputs, add inert manifest passthrough (fields filled in T-0243).
8. Data wipe migration: `TRUNCATE combine_dailies; DELETE FROM progress WHERE kind='combine';` (SQL snippet in commit for user to run).

**Not in scope (still T-0241):** `GameState.manifest` + `manifestFound` + manifest-based win condition. The engine refuses to end a daily run on its own after this step — runs only end on 'board clogs'. That's intentional — the T-0241 engine win logic shipped on top will fix it. (Admin cannot schedule a non-empty manifest yet either, so there's no live-gameplay regression: today's daily only has guestIngredient configured, not a manifest.)

**Tests:**
- Delete tests for removed functions.
- Keep + add manifest validation cases.
- `buildDailyPayload` emits required manifest field.

**ENGINE_VERSION:** 2 → 3 (field removed from state shape = scoring-affecting under the hard rule).
**Deploy risk:** destructive — user explicitly approved the wipe; in-flight server runs 409-reconcile on next checkpoint.
**T-0241 scope** shrinks to: add `GameState.manifest` + `manifestFound`, add manifest-win in `afterMove`, thread through the server start route. No engine-version bump there (bundled into this step).

title: Combine manifest · step 2: engine (GameState.manifest, win condition, ENGINE_VERSION 3)
body:
**Step 2 of 6** per `docs/COMBINE_DAILY_MANIFEST.md`. The reducer change — **scoring-affecting, ENGINE_VERSION 2→3 bump.**

**Scope:**
1. `GameState`: add `manifest: string[] | null` + `manifestFound: string[]`.
2. `newGame` accepts optional `manifest` param; defaults to null for endless/fast/legacy-daily.
3. `cloneState` / snapshot copies both new fields.
4. Discovery update (in `finishResolve` where `found.push(recipe.out)` lands): if `state.manifest` contains the new item, insert into `manifestFound` preserving manifest order.
5. Win condition in `afterMove`: when `state.manifest != null`, win is `manifestFound.length >= manifest.length`. Legacy `target`-based win stays for null-manifest dailies.
6. **Bump `ENGINE_VERSION` from 2 to 3** at `src/combine/engine.ts:66`.
7. Server bundle load (`bundleForRun`) + run start (`/runs/start`) threads the manifest from the daily payload through to `newGame`.
8. `/runs/[id]/finish` stamps `progress.result.manifestFound` + `manifestSize` on daily rows for the leaderboard sort.

**Not in scope:** dealer partner-bias (step 6), UI (step 5), scheduler generation (step 3). This step only makes the engine *capable* of a manifest run; no daily has one yet.

**Tests:**
- `__tests__/engine.test.ts` — add cases: manifest run wins only when all items made; discoveries not in manifest don't bump `manifestFound`; cloneState roundtrip.
- Existing engine tests stay green.

**Deploy risk:** in-flight server runs get 409 on next checkpoint and reconcile with a fresh server-authoritative state. No data loss, just a run restart. User greenlit "land it ASAP" per T-0237 planning.

Depends on T-0240 (needs the manifest field in DailyPayload to read from).

title: Combine manifest · step 3: scheduler + reachability simulator
body:
**Step 3 of 6** per `docs/COMBINE_DAILY_MANIFEST.md`. The generator that turns `DailyConfig.manifest` into a concrete `DailyPayload.manifest: string[]` per day, with reachability guarantees.

**Scope:**
1. New module `src/combine/manifest-solver.ts`:
   - `isReachable(id, cappedBundle): boolean` — transitive closure over `byIngredient`. Memoise per bundle.
   - `simulateReachable(manifest, bundle, seed, turnBudget): boolean` — headless greedy solver using the real `reduce` + `dealTray`. Picks moves BFS-nearest to next unfound manifest item. Returns true iff all items found within budget.
   - `buildManifestForDay(fullBundle, cappedBundle, config, day, rotation): string[]` — validates pins, samples the pool with rotation weighting (mirror `pickGuests`), calls `simulateReachable`, retries up to 3× on failure. Throws `UnreachableManifest` / `UnreachablePin` with suggested near-matches.
2. Wire into `daily-schedule-db.ts` — when `activeDaily.config.manifest` is set, call `buildManifestForDay` from the schedule-build path; freeze result into `DailyPayload.manifest`.
3. Admin preview endpoint `src/app/api/admin/combine/daily/preview-manifest/route.ts` — runs the generator for a given day and returns `{ pinned: string[], generated: string[], turnsToSolve: number | null, error?: string }`. Admin-gated.
4. Pool resolver: given `config.manifest.pool` (combine_themes.code), fetch member item ids via `item_combine_themes`. Export from a new helper so the admin UI and the solver share it.
5. Unit tests: solver memoisation; reachability transitive closure; simulator terminates on unreachable manifest within budget.

**Not in scope:** admin UI (step 4), player UI (step 5). The admin can hit the preview endpoint directly to verify; the generator runs invisibly on schedule rebuild.

**Budget:** <100ms per day via memoised reachability. Simulator bounded by `turnBudget = 2 * size * 20 = 320` turns default.

**ENGINE_VERSION:** not bumped (solver is read-only over bundles; no reducer change).

Depends on T-0241 (engine needs to accept manifests); technically only depends on T-0240 for the config shape, but step 4 (admin UI) will want T-0241 in place to see the win condition work on preview runs.

title: Combine manifest · step 4: admin UI (radio toggle, pool picker, pins, preview)
body:
**Step 4 of 6** per `docs/COMBINE_DAILY_MANIFEST.md`. Surfaces manifest curation in `/admin/combine/daily`.

**Scope** — in `src/app/admin/combine/daily/DailyAdmin.tsx`:
1. Radio toggle in the "Daily shape" card: `( ) Target count   ( ) Manifest`. Persists via the existing config save endpoint.
2. When Manifest is selected:
   - **Pool** dropdown — combine_themes with any members (reuse the admin themes listing).
   - **Size** integer input, 6–12, default 8.
   - **Partner bias** float, default 0.3.
   - **Pinned items** list with "+ Add pin" typeahead over the resolved pool. Each pin shows a reachability chip (`reachable` ✓ / `unreachable — try X, Y` ✕).
3. "Preview today's manifest" button — calls `GET /api/admin/combine/daily/preview-manifest?day=…` from step 3. Shows pinned + generated sections, turns-to-solve estimate, and a hard-fail banner if unreachable.
4. The existing Schedule section continues to render; manifest rows show item pictograms inline where `guests` previously rendered (reuse the chip primitive).

**Server validation:** the save endpoint runs `normaliseDailyConfig` (from step 1), rejects on mutually-exclusive `manifest + targetDiscoveries`, and additionally validates `pool` exists + pins resolve. Unresolved pins return 400 with `{ unresolvedExamples }` so the UI can surface them.

**Not in scope:** player UI (step 5).

Depends on T-0242 (preview endpoint + pool resolver live there).

title: Combine manifest · step 5: player UI (start-sheet grid, in-run tracker, end-card)
body:
**Step 5 of 6** per `docs/COMBINE_DAILY_MANIFEST.md`. The player-visible surface for manifest dailies.

**Daily-only.** Endless/fast UI is untouched — the manifest grid, tracker pill, and end-card panel only render when `state.manifest != null` (which is always true for daily post-T-0240 rip-out, but the guard keeps the code honest).

**Scope:**
1. **JourneySheet becomes the manifest hub** (`src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/JourneySheet.tsx`):
   - `DailyJourney` branch now shows the manifest grid (4×2 pictogram tiles) instead of the flat `state.found` list.
   - Each tile: found items render dimmed-tier-colour + check glyph; unfound items full-colour. Tap -> existing `onInfo(id)` opens DetailCard.
   - Header copy: "Daily — N of M manifest items" (was "N of 40 discoveries").
   - Keep the turns/leaderboard copy below the grid — still true.
2. **Start-daily sheet** (extend the sheet landed in T-0236 inside `CombineBoard.tsx`):
   - Render the manifest as the same 4×2 pictogram grid above the Start button.
   - Copy: "Today's manifest — find these N:".
   - Pictogram-only on narrow widths (<340px) with tap-to-reveal name.
3. **In-run tracker pill** — compact bar above the shelf:
   - One line: `Manifest  3/8  ›` (chevron → opens JourneySheet).
   - Only renders when `state.manifest != null`.
   - No new component — small enough to live inline in CombineBoard above the Shelf. (Avoiding the separate `ManifestTracker.tsx` dropped from the original plan.)
4. **End-card manifest summary** (`GameOverCard.tsx`):
   - Replace the "new discoveries" chip row with the same 4×2 grid (reuse the shared primitive).
   - Progress bar: `manifestFound / manifest.length`.
   - Missed items render muted + ✗ glyph; found get ✓.
   - `won = manifestFound.length >= manifest.length`.
   - Title copy: "Daily complete" vs "Daily stopped" keyed off `won`.
5. **Share string:** extend `dailyShareText` in `src/combine/share.ts` to format manifest runs as `Daily YYYY-MM-DD · 8/8 · 34t · 3:47`.

**Shared primitive:** extract a `ManifestGrid` presentational component (lives alongside GameOverCard or in `board-parts/`) so the start-sheet, JourneySheet daily branch, and end-card all render identical grids with per-call `showChecks` / `size` tweaks.

**CSS** — new modifiers in `globals.css`:
- `.cbmanifest` (shared grid wrapper, used by 3 surfaces).
- `.cbmanifest-tile` (per-item tile; found/unfound variants).
- `.cbmanifest-trackerpill` (one-line in-run bar).

**Not in scope:** dealer partner-bias (step 6).

Depends on T-0243 (admin surface) so there's something to test against.

comments.body:
**Landed.**

**New shared primitive** (`src/components/combine/board-parts/ManifestGrid.tsx`): one 4-column pictogram grid used by all three player surfaces. Two render modes:
- `mode="progress"` (start-sheet + JourneySheet): unfound tiles stay vivid (tier colour + border), found tiles dim to ~55% opacity but keep the frame so the eye is pulled to what's still to do. Check glyph in the top-right corner for found items.
- `mode="end"` (GameOverCard post-run): found get ✓, missed render muted + desaturated with a ✗. `showChecks`/`size` variants collapsed into the single `mode` prop since there's no third variant.

Tiles are tappable buttons when `onInfo` is passed (JourneySheet + end-card); the start-sheet renders non-interactive spans since no DetailCard is wanted pre-run.

**Start-daily sheet** (`CombineBoard.tsx`): when `state.manifest` is populated, the sheet shows "Find these N" + the manifest grid above the Start button. Dismissing confirms Start (unchanged from T-0236). Fallback "Ready?" copy still shows for manifest-less daily (the T-0240 interlude).

**In-run tracker pill**: inline above the Shelf, centred. Shows `Manifest  3/8  ›`. Taps through to the JourneySheet (reuses the existing `setAgesOpen(true)` path). Flips to `.cbmanifest-pill.done` with the accent colour once every item is found.

**JourneySheet daily branch**: rebuilt around the ManifestGrid. Header reads "Daily — N of M manifest items" with a "T to find · M turns" progress line. Tapping a tile opens DetailCard via the existing `onInfo` hook. Items the player made that aren't on the manifest render in a compact "Extra discoveries" list below.

**GameOverCard**:
- `won = state.manifestFound.length >= state.manifest.length` (daily + non-empty manifest only).
- Daily stats grid: "manifest N / M" in the discoveries column.
- "New discoveries" chip row replaced with the ManifestGrid in `mode="end"` for manifest runs.
- Sub-headline shows "Found every item in T turns" on win, else "N / M manifest items in T turns. The board ran out." on partial.

**Share string** (`share.ts`): manifest runs emit "🟩🟩⬜⬜⬜⬜⬜⬜ 2/8 in 34 turns" (one square per manifest slot, filled for found) instead of the chapter-progression line. Legacy no-manifest dailies keep the old line.

**CSS** (`globals.css`): added `.cbmanifest` grid + `.cbmanifest-tile` + found/missed modifiers + `.cbmanifest-check` / `.cbmanifest-cross` glyphs + `.cbmanifest-pill` with a `.done` state. 4-column responsive via `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))`; a narrow-screen media query tightens the padding + pictogram size.

**Verified:** typecheck + lint (only pre-existing warnings) + 465 tests pass + build green.

**Not verified:** live browser interaction — the harness can't drive the UI. User should UAT: start a daily, confirm the start sheet shows the manifest grid, verify the tracker pill above the shelf, tap through to the JourneySheet, play through, confirm the end-card renders the manifest summary with the right ✓/✗ tiles.

Status → done.

title: Combine manifest · step 6: dealer partner-bias toward unfound manifest items
body:
**Step 6 of 6** per `docs/COMBINE_DAILY_MANIFEST.md`. Optional dealer tweak; player UI from step 5 works correctly without it.

**Daily-only.** Dealer bias only applies when `state.manifest != null` — endless/fast dealers untouched.

**Scope:**
1. In `src/combine/deal.ts`, in the dealer's weighting pass:
   - When `state.manifest != null`, compute the set of **direct partners** of unfound manifest items (the `in` sides of recipes that would produce an unfound manifest item).
   - Multiply the dealer weight for those tile ids by `(1 + state.manifest.partnerBias)` where `partnerBias` defaults to 0.3 (threaded from `DailyPayload.manifest.partnerBias` via the server's run start → engine → state).
   - The multiplier does **not** apply once the manifest item is found — weights revert for that item's partners.
2. Memoise the partner set per-bundle; recompute only when `manifestFound` changes.
3. **Scoring-affecting via dealer bias:** this changes which tiles appear, which affects score. Needs **ENGINE_VERSION bump** — but bump is already done in step 2 (T-0241), and step 6 ships behind the same bump since no prod daily has a manifest yet. If step 6 lands after player UI is live, it needs a separate bump.

**Tests:**
- Deal with a manifest + partnerBias=0.5: verify unfound-manifest partners appear at the expected ~1.5× rate over a large sample.
- Found items drop out of the bias set.
- partnerBias=0 → dealer identical to the non-manifest path.

**Why last:** this is a feel/tuning tweak. If step 5 playtesting shows the dealer isn't fair without a bias, we land this; if players can already solve manifests reliably at `partnerBias=0`, we can defer indefinitely.

Depends on T-0244 (player UI must be live so we can playtest and see whether bias is even needed).

title: fix(combine): theme member removal fails with "malformed array literal"
body:
Deleting items from a Combine theme at `/admin/combine/themes` throws Postgres error 22P02 (`malformed array literal: "<uuid>"`) and the removal fails.

**Root cause:** `countUsersAffectedByItemRemoval` in `src/combine/completion-impact.ts:36` uses a raw `sql\`${col} = ANY(${itemIds})\`` template. Drizzle's `sql` template binds the JS `itemIds` array as a single parameter, but the pg driver can't infer the `uuid[]` target type here and sends it as a scalar string, so Postgres sees `$2 = '<uuid>'` (not `'{<uuid>}'`) and rejects it as a malformed array literal.

**Fix:** replace with Drizzle's `inArray(schema.combineDiscoveries.itemId, itemIds)` — consistent with every other array-membership check in the repo.

Logs: 22P02 fires repeatedly from the `/admin/combine-themes/[id]/members` POST path.

Single file change: `src/combine/completion-impact.ts`.

- Drop `sql` from the imports if no other usage remains in the file (there's one more for the JSON ->> cast in `countUsersCompletedAtVersion`, so keep it).
- Add `inArray` to the drizzle-orm import.

No schema change, no behavior change beyond fixing the crash — the SELECT is semantically identical.

Verification: `npm run typecheck`. Can't repro the admin flow against prod from here, but the fix is isomorphic to every other membership check in the repo (e.g. the sibling route uses `inArray` already on line 155).

title: Combine daily: server-authoritative start-daily (anti-peek)
body:
Playtest leak: player taps Start on the daily sheet, peeks at the tray/board, then reloads. On reload the gate effect re-opens the sheet (because `state.moves === 0`) BUT the peek already happened + the clock resets because `dailyStartRef` is in-memory only.

Fix: move the "started" marker server-side.

**Scope:**
1. Schema: add `startedAt: timestamp` column to `combine_runs` (nullable, defaults null).
2. New endpoint `POST /api/combine/runs/[id]/start-daily`: owner-scoped, sets `startedAt = now()` if null (idempotent — second call is a no-op). Admin-gated feature: same auth as other run endpoints.
3. `/runs/start` + `/runs/active` responses include `startedAt`.
4. `/runs/[id]/finish`: when `run.startedAt` is non-null, compute `durationMs = now - startedAt` server-side. Client-reported `durationMs` becomes a soft hint (dropped). **Honest anti-cheat.**
5. Client (`useCombineRun`): expose `startedAt` on the run context. `confirmStartDaily` POSTs to the new endpoint before closing the sheet.
6. Gate effect in `CombineBoard`: check `run.context.startedAt === null` instead of `dailyStartRef.current === null`. Local `dailyStartRef` becomes a fallback for offline/server-runs-off mode.

**No ENGINE_VERSION bump** — `startedAt` lives on the DB row, not in `GameState`.

**Deploy note:** DB migration first, then ship. Migration is additive (new nullable column) so no downtime.

comments.body:
**Landed.**

**Schema:**
- Added `startedAt: timestamp` to `combine_runs` (nullable). Migration `drizzle/0030_glorious_quicksilver.sql` — additive, zero downtime.

**Server:**
- `run-store.markRunStarted(runId, owner)` — idempotent, sets `startedAt = now()` on an active run if null. Returns the row.
- New endpoint `POST /api/combine/runs/[id]/start-daily` — owner-scoped, rate-limited via the shared `combineRun` bucket. Returns `{ runId, startedAt }`.
- `/runs/start` + `/runs/active` responses now include `startedAt` (ISO string or null).
- `/runs/[id]/finish`: `durationMs` is now **server-computed** as `Date.now() - run.startedAt.getTime()` (clamped at 24h). Client-reported `durationMs` is kept as a soft fallback only when `startedAt` is null (shouldn't happen for a valid daily; belt-and-suspenders).

**Client:**
- `useCombineRun.RunContext.startedAt: string | null` (new field).
- `useCombineRun.markStartedDaily()` — POSTs to the new endpoint, updates `context.startedAt` optimistically on success.
- `CombineBoard.confirmStartDaily` fires `markStartedDaily()` fire-and-forget after flipping local state. Failures leave the player with the pre-T-0247 behaviour (client-measured clock) — acceptable fallback.
- Gate effect in `CombineBoard` now checks `run.context?.startedAt` first. If set, the sheet stays closed on reload. The `dailyStartRef` + `state.moves > 0` checks remain as fallbacks for the server-runs-off path.

**Anti-peek now works:**
1. Player taps Start → server stamps `startedAt`.
2. Player peeks + reloads → `/runs/start` returns the resumed run with `startedAt` set → gate effect sees `startedAt` → sheet doesn't open → shimmer stays over the board. The peek cost zero elapsed clock time to detect, but now there IS elapsed clock time because the server-side timestamp is ticking.
3. At finish → `durationMs` is `now - startedAt`, not `now - some-in-memory-ref`, so the peek-and-reload tax is baked in.

**Verified:** typecheck + 468 tests + build all green.

**Deploy note:** run `npm run db:migrate` to apply `0030_glorious_quicksilver.sql` before shipping. No existing data is touched.

Status → done.

title: Combine mode/theme picker: visually distinguish current mode from selected mode
body:
In the ModeThemePicker sheet (/combine mode+theme dialog), when the current running mode is Tutorial, the Endless tile reads as "selected/current" because it carries the ink `on` background (set by `initialMode`). Tutorial gets only a purple border accent. There is no explicit "current" indicator distinct from the user's pending selection.

Fix: give the tile matching the actively-running mode a purple (accent) background treatment so it clearly reads as "this is what you're playing now", separate from the ink `on` style for the user's pending selection.

Files: src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/ModeThemePicker.tsx (plus the call site in CombineBoard.tsx needs to pass through the current-tutorial signal if the sheet is to recognize tutorial as the current mode).

comments.body:
Approach:

- Add a `current` CSS class on `.cbmtpTile` that fills with `--accent` (purple) and sets text to white — same visual as the "Restart current run" button, so "this is what you're playing now" reads consistently across the sheet.
- Compute `current: PickerMode | "tutorial"` inside the picker from `currentMode` + `currentDaily`:
  - `currentDaily` → `"daily"`
  - `currentMode === "fast"` → `"fast"`
  - `currentMode === "tutorial"` → `"tutorial"` (so the Tutorial card lights up when the player opens the sheet mid-tutorial)
  - otherwise `"endless"`
- Precedence: when `current === pending selection`, show the purple `current` style (not the ink `on`). When the user taps a different mode, that tile goes ink `on`, and the current tile stays purple. This gives an always-visible "what's running" vs "what will apply when I confirm".
- Also apply the same treatment to the theme row: the tile matching `currentTheme` (when not in daily mode and when it equals the pending selection) gets the purple fill. Keeps the mental model consistent between mode and theme rows.
- `initialMode` in state can keep `currentMode === "fast" ? "fast" : "endless"` fallback for tutorial — tapping Endless/Fast/Daily/Tutorial still updates `mode` as before; the Tutorial card is still a bypass-confirm path, no change there.

No call-site changes needed in CombineBoard.tsx — `state.mode` already carries "tutorial" and is passed in.

Landed in `src/components/combine/board-parts/overlays/ModeThemePicker.tsx`:

- `PickerMode` widened to include `"tutorial"` so the Tutorial card participates in the same "current" highlight logic as the other tiles.
- Added `currentPickerMode` derived from `currentMode`/`currentDaily` (`daily` | `fast` | `tutorial` | `endless`) — the actively-running mode, separate from `mode` (pending selection).
- New `.cbmtpTile.current` CSS: `--accent` fill + white text, matching the "Restart current run" button's visual language. Wins over `.on` when both apply (e.g., picker just opened and the user hasn't changed selection yet).
- Mode tiles (incl. Tutorial card) and theme tiles both carry `.current` when they match what's playing. Theme row applies `.current` only outside daily and only for endless/fast runs (daily overrides the theme row).
- `initialMode` removed. Pending `mode` seeds from `currentPickerMode`, falling back to `"endless"` when tutorial is current (no re-confirm-into-tutorial path — the Tutorial card remains a bypass-confirm click).
- `dirty` now compares against `currentPickerMode` instead of the picker's seeded `mode`, so when the player opens the picker mid-tutorial the confirm button is live ("Play Endless · <theme>") rather than wrongly saying "Already playing this".
- aria-labels updated to announce "currently playing" on the current tile.
- ✓ (done chip) got a `.current` override so it stays readable on purple.

`npm run typecheck` and `eslint` on the file both clean. No call-site changes in CombineBoard.tsx — `state.mode` already carries `"tutorial"` and flows straight through. Not run in a browser.
